EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Commercial and press reporting states that merchant traffic reports GNSS position jumps of 3-8nm in the central strait.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Mirenda, Stellar Vane.

3. The publication does not identify its own sourcing and gives no dateline beyond 1603Z.

4. Schedule data show 5 affected sailings, all within the period 1417Z to 0902Z.

5. The same account appears in 8 outlets within 90 hours, with wording sufficiently similar to suggest a single origin.

6. The account has not been corroborated by any other discipline.
